title: Saudi Arabian Ham and Serrano Tagine
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian-inspired stew made with tender ham, spicy serrano peppers, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the diced ham and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced serrano peppers, crumbly Saudi Arabian spice mix, Arabian tagine spice blend, and quenched lemon juice.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
